name: Stablezact Stablecoin & Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: stablezact

sections.description:
Turn crypto wallets into paying customers

Give customers another way to pay on your WooCommerce store without changing how you price or sell your products.
With Stablezact, customers can pay from their crypto wallets at checkout while you choose how you want to receive the money.
Get settled in stablecoins to a wallet you control, or receive supported currencies directly into your verified bank account.
Your customers get the convenience of paying with crypto. You decide how your business gets paid.

Accept wallet payments without changing your store

Your WooCommerce store continues to display products and prices in the currencies you already use.
At checkout, customers can choose Stablezact and complete payment from a supported crypto wallet.
Stablezact connects your checkout to 300+ wallets and 60+ blockchain networks, making it easier for customers to pay using the wallet and network they already use.
No card details are required for the Stablezact payment.

Choose how you receive your money

Stablezact gives merchants two settlement options. Your settlement preference is configured in your Stablezact merchant account.

Stablecoin settlement

Receive supported stablecoins directly into a wallet you control.
Stablezact is non-custodial for wallet settlement. Your funds are not stored in a Stablezact merchant balance waiting for withdrawal.

Bank settlement

Prefer money in your bank account instead?
Eligible merchants can convert supported payments and receive settlement into their verified bank account through Stablezact’s supported settlement partners.
USD settlement is supported across 180+ countries.
Supported bank settlement currencies include:
USD, BRL, CNY, COP, EUR, GBP, HKD, MXN, NGN, PHP, SGD and AED.
Availability depends on the merchant’s country, eligibility, settlement currency and the requirements of the relevant settlement partner.

Sell globally. Get paid your way.

Stablezact is built for merchants selling to customers across borders.
Instead of asking customers to find another payment method, your store can accept payment directly from the crypto wallets they already use.
And accepting a crypto payment does not mean your business has to hold crypto.
Choose stablecoin settlement when you want funds in your wallet.
Choose bank settlement when you want supported local or international currency deposited into your bank account.

How it works

  1. Your customer shops on your WooCommerce store as normal.
  2. At checkout, they select Stablezact as their payment method.
  3. They connect or open their preferred supported crypto wallet.
  4. They confirm the payment/transfer to an address.
  5. Stablezact verifies the transaction and updates the WooCommerce order.
  6. You receive settlement based on your configured settlement option.

Your existing WooCommerce order and fulfilment flow remains in place.

Why merchants use Stablezact

Reach customers who prefer paying from crypto wallets
Turn wallet holders into customers instead of losing them because your checkout only accepts traditional payment methods.

Receive stablecoins without giving up control of your funds
For wallet settlement, payments are settled to wallets you control.

Receive money in your bank account
Eligible merchants can accept wallet payments while receiving supported currencies into their verified bank account.

Give customers more freedom at checkout
Customers can pay through 300+ supported wallets across 60+ blockchain networks.

Reduce dependence on cross-border card payments
Give international customers another way to complete purchases without relying only on cards.

Keep WooCommerce at the centre of your business
Orders, payment status and transaction information remain connected to your WooCommerce workflow.

Who is Stablezact for?

Stablezact is suitable for WooCommerce businesses that:

  • Sell to customers internationally.
  • Have customers who already hold stablecoins or other supported digital assets.
  • Want to accept USDC or USDT payments.
  • Want an alternative to card-only checkout.
  • Want stablecoin payments settled directly to their own wallet.
  • Want eligible crypto payments converted and deposited into a bank account.
  • Sell digital or physical products through WooCommerce.
  • Need another payment option for cross-border customers.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Stablezact payment service, which is required for it to function as a payment gateway.

When a customer chooses to pay with Stablezact, the plugin sends the order amount, currency, an order reference, and your merchant public key to create and verify the payment. It also retrieves current exchange rates from the same service. No customer card details are ever handled, and no data is sent unless the customer selects this payment method. During payment, the customer’s own wallet software connects to its blockchain network to complete the transaction.

The service is operated by Stablezact FINTECH LTD. By using this plugin you agree to Stablezact’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
Terms of Service: https://stablezact.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://stablezact.com/privacy

Support

For support, please visit Stablezact Support.
sections.installation:
Getting started

  1. Install and activate Stablezact for WooCommerce.
  2. Create your Stablezact merchant account.
  3. Complete the required merchant verification.
  4. Connect Stablezact to WooCommerce.
  5. Choose your available settlement preference.
  6. Enable Stablezact in WooCommerce Payments.
  7. Start accepting wallet payments.
sections.faq:
What does Stablezact do?

Stablezact lets WooCommerce merchants accept payments from customers using supported crypto wallets.
Depending on your eligibility and configuration, settlement can be made in supported stablecoins to your own wallet or in supported currencies to your verified bank account.

Do I need to hold crypto to accept crypto payments?

Not necessarily.
If you choose stablecoin settlement, you receive supported stablecoins into the wallet you configure.
Eligible merchants can instead use bank settlement, where supported payments are converted and settled into their verified bank account through supported settlement partners.

Which stablecoins can I accept?

Stablezact supports stablecoin payments including USDC and USDT.
Available assets and networks can vary. The current options available to your merchant account are shown in the Stablezact dashboard.

Which wallets can customers use?

Customers can pay from 300+ supported crypto wallets.
This includes popular mobile wallets, browser wallets and WalletConnect-compatible wallets.

Which blockchain networks are supported?

Stablezact supports payments across 60+ blockchain networks.
Customers do not have to use the same blockchain network that you use for settlement.
Available networks and payment assets are displayed during checkout and within the Stablezact platform.

Can I receive payments directly into my bank account?

Eligible merchants can choose bank settlement in supported countries and currencies.
USD settlement is available across 180+ countries.
Supported settlement currencies currently include USD, BRL, CNY, COP, EUR, GBP, HKD, MXN, NGN, PHP, SGD and AED.
Bank settlement availability is subject to merchant verification, country availability and the requirements of Stablezact’s settlement partners.

Can I receive payments directly into my own crypto wallet?

Yes.
For supported stablecoin settlement, funds are settled to the wallet addresses configured by your business.
Stablezact does not require you to maintain a custodial Stablezact wallet balance before withdrawing your funds.

Does my customer need a Stablezact account?

No.
Customers pay from their supported crypto wallet during checkout.

Do I need a Stablezact merchant account?

Yes.
A Stablezact merchant account is required to configure your payment and settlement settings and connect the service to WooCommerce.

Does Stablezact replace WooCommerce?

No.
Stablezact adds another payment option to your WooCommerce checkout. Your products, orders, fulfilment and normal WooCommerce workflow remain in place.

Can international customers use Stablezact?

Yes, subject to supported jurisdictions and payment availability.
Stablezact is designed to help merchants accept wallet payments from customers across different markets and blockchain networks.

Where can I get support?

Visit the Stablezact support page for setup assistance, payment questions or technical support.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

  • Changed: the dashboard shows your total volume in US dollars, the currency payments settle in, with an approximate conversion to your store currency underneath.
  • Changed: the plugin name now matches the name shown on WordPress.org.

1.2.2

  • Changed: simplified the connect screen and removed the setup notice from the admin screens.

1.2.1

  • Changed: activating the plugin opens the Stablezact connect screen, so you can see and manage the connection straight away. Your saved settings and connected account are kept.
  • Changed: the External Services notice no longer lists the service address.

1.2.0

  • Added: a redesigned dashboard, transactions list and settings screen, with network logos and block explorer links throughout.
  • Added: transactions can be filtered by status, network, currency and date, exported to CSV, and are now paginated.
  • Changed: the checkout total is read at the moment payment starts, so the amount charged always matches the order, including discounts applied on the checkout page.
  • Changed: your settings and connected account are preserved when the plugin is reactivated.
  • Changed: supported tokens and fee details shown for each network now come from your account rather than a fixed list.
  • Changed: improved handling of stored account data and debug logging.

1.1.9

  • Changed: first-time setup now saves your Public Key reliably when enabling the gateway.
  • Changed: fee information is shown read-only and reflects the rate set on your account.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.1.8

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
